rates.text:
Be the first to savor the season at Montauk Yacht Club. From April 1 through May 21, enjoy up to 25% off — plus a waived Water Club fee.
Spring in Montauk offers crisp ocean air, serene marina mornings, and the kind of coastal calm you can only experience before summer begins. This is Montauk, unhurried.
rates.cancellationText: Cancellations made at least 14 days prior to arrival will receive a full refund of the deposit.
rates.guaranteePolicy: First night room, tax and resort fee is due at the time of booking. Remainder of the deposit will be collected 14 days prior to arrival. Must be 21 to check in.

guarantee.description: First night room, tax and resort fee is due at the time of booking. Remainder of the deposit will be collected 14 days prior to arrival. Must be 21 to check in.
